title: Network Rework Authorization Under the Workmanship Warranties: Signing Card
content:
**Subject.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a covered concern whose remedy is a network rework at a network center is recorded with the rework courtesy rental days the network pays for it. Once recorded, the concern carries its network rework authorization: the authorized remedy attempt, the network center doing the rework and the courtesy rental days the network pays with it.

| Recorded on the authorization | Content |
|---|---|
| Remedy | network rework, at the named network center |
| Attempt | the ordinal of this remedy attempt on the concern |
| Courtesy rental | the rework courtesy rental days the network pays with this rework, 0 when none |
| Date | the date of signing |

## The action: `sign_rework_authorization_70486d76`

**Capability.** The customer signs the authorization for a network rework of a covered concern on their workmanship warranty coverage, at a network center, for a rework that disturbs no driver-assistance sensor. Signing records one remedy authorization for that concern, dated today, as a network rework at the named center with the courtesy rental days the network pays; the coverage's concern history then shows the authorized remedy attempt.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `sign_rework_authorization_70486d76` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to sign the authorization.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_coverage_id` | Reference number of the warranty coverage the covered concern belongs to, as returned by the warranty coverage lookup | text reference number |
| `concern_number` | Ordinal of the covered concern on that coverage, exactly as shown on the concern's report and inspection entries | integer, 1 or more |
| `rework_attempt` | Ordinal of this remedy attempt on the concern | integer, 1 or more |
| `location_code` | Code of the network center doing the rework, as shown on the center's entries in the concern history | 3 upper-case letters, hyphen, 4 digits |
| `courtesy_rental_days` | Courtesy rental days the network pays with this rework | whole number of rental days; 0 when none |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` "authorized", `warranty_event_id` (the authorization's reference number), `concern_number`, `rework_attempt`, `rework_kind` (always `network_rework`), `location_code`, `courtesy_rental_days` and `event_date` (the authorization date, YYYY-MM-DD). The receipt's reference number confirms the authorization is recorded.
